fields.organization: Site Health Team, Soma Valley Site 2
fields.caseDefinition: Suspected case: a person aged 2 or more with acute watery diarrhoea. Confirmed case: positive culture or rapid test followed by laboratory confirmation.
fields.response: Oral rehydration points opened in blocks A and B; chlorination at all water points; hygiene messages by community mobilisers.
needs: Treatment centre beds: 20 more for block B
